expressions.name: Expr
expressions.doc:
The base class for all expressions in a syntax tree. Each Expr encapsulates any necessary
context, such as its child expressions, their names (arg keys), and whether a given child expression
is optional or not.

expressions.name: Condition
expressions.doc: Logical conditions like x AND y, or simply x

expressions.name: Predicate
expressions.doc: Any condition that evaluates to a boolean, e.g. x = y, x LIKE 'a%', a @> b.

expressions.name: Func
expressions.doc: The base class for all function expressions.

expressions.name: Kwarg
expressions.doc: Kwarg in special functions like func(kwarg => y).

expressions.name: TimeUnit
expressions.doc: Automatically converts unit arg into a var.

expressions.name: _TimeUnit
expressions.doc: Automatically converts unit arg into a var.

expressions.name: FormatPhrase
expressions.doc:
Format override for a column in Teradata.
Can be expanded to additional dialects as needed

expressions.name: Query
expressions.doc: Trait for any SELECT/UNION/etc. query expression.

expressions.name: Tag
expressions.doc: Tags are used for generating arbitrary sql like SELECT x.

expressions.name: DML
expressions.doc: Trait for data manipulation language statements.

expressions.name: Whens
expressions.doc: Wraps around one or more WHEN [NOT] MATCHED [...] clauses.

expressions.name: Space
expressions.doc: SPACE(n) → string consisting of n blank characters
